content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Technician Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 30 years Age Relaxation can be given to the exceptional candidate based on the recommendations by the committee. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Technician Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HBCHRC Technician Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the HBCHRC recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the HBCHRC recruitment is Technician (CSSD).

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been announced for the Technician (CSSD) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 18th August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Technician (CSSD) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have 12th Std. in Science with a Diploma in C.S.S.D. and 3 years of experience, or a B.Sc. Graduate with 1 year of experience in C.S.S.D.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for this position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technician (CSSD) post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Technician (CSSD) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 23,870/- Per Month.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview venue is HRD Department, first floor, Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital Research Centre, Visakhapatnam.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry their updated resume, passport-size photograph, Pan Card, Aadhar card, original certificates, and self-attested copies of all certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation available?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation can be given to exceptional candidates based on committee recommendations.
